name: NGC 298, SN 1986K field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 298, a spiral galaxy in Cetus that hosted a Type II supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1986khost-hubble
story: In 1986 a star in this spiral galaxy exploded as a Type II supernova, SN 1986K. Hubble returned to study the aftermath, part of a search for clues to how such explosions begin.

claims.text: NGC 298 is a spiral galaxy in Cetus
NGC 298 hosted a Type II supernova in 1986
SN 1986K is a Type II supernova whose host is NGC 298
The Hubble image was part of a study of how Type II supernovae originate
